set system host-name [parameter1].explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set routing-options static route [parame.explanation: This command configures a static route in Junos, where `[parameter1]` is the destination network and `[parameter2]` is the subnet mask.

preference [parameter4].explanation: The command `preference [parameter4]` sets the administrative preference value for a routing protocol or route, influencing route selection in Junos OS.

parameters.name: preference
parameters.explanation: The lower the priority, the higher the value.

set firewall family inet filter [paramet.command: set firewall family inet filter acl-3001
set firewall family inet filter [paramet.explanation: This command fragment configures an IPv4 firewall filter named `[parameter1]` in Junos OS, defining rules to control traffic based on specified conditions.

term [parameter2].explanation: This command fragment creates a term within an IPv4 firewall filter, where `[parameter1]` is the filter name and `[parameter2]` is the term name.

from source-address [parameter3]/[parame.explanation: Configures the source address conditions for access to the control list.

parameters.name: subnet-mask
parameters.explanation: Number of subnet masks in source IP address.

from destination-address [parameter3]/[p.explanation: The command filters traffic based on the destination IP address range specified by `[parameter3]` (IP address) and `[parameter4]` (subnet mask or prefix length).

parameters.name: prefix-length
parameters.explanation: prefix length of the destination network.

then [parameter3].explanation: Configure firewall filter terminologies and accept all traffic.

parameters.name: action
parameters.explanation: Action, accept indicates acceptance of traffic.

set policy-options policy-statement [par.explanation: This command fragment defines a routing policy named `[parameter1]` in Junos, allowing you to configure specific routing rules, actions, and conditions for traffic control.

term [parameter2].explanation: This command fragment configures a routing policy by defining a term within a policy statement, where `[parameter1]` is the policy name and `[parameter2]` is the term name.

parameters.name: term
parameters.explanation: The term number of the policy statement.

from filter [parameter3].explanation: The command `from filter [parameter3]` in Junos specifies a source filter condition, applying the filter named `[parameter3]` to match traffic based on defined criteria.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.explanation: The name of the filter used to match.

then next-hop [parameter3].explanation: The command `then next-hop [parameter3]` in Junos sets the next-hop IP address for traffic matching a specific route or filter to the value specified in `[parameter3]`.

then precedence [parameter3].explanation: The command `then precedence [parameter3]` sets the IP precedence (priority) value in the packet header to the specified `[parameter3]` value (0-7) for traffic matching the filter.

unit [parameter2].explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

family inet service input [parameter3].explanation: The command configures the input service filter for IPv4 traffic, applying specific service rules defined by `[parameter3]` to incoming packets on the interface.

family inet address [parameter3].explanation: The command `family inet address [parameter3]` configures an IPv4 address (`[parameter3]`) on an interface in Junos OS.

delete interfaces [parameter1].explanation: The command fragment `delete interfaces [parameter1]` removes the configuration for the specified interface (`[parameter1]`) from the Junos device.

disable.explanation: Deletes the disablement status of the interface and allows the interface to be enabled.
